mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders(user_id, order_type, total_amount, status, idempotency_key,create_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderType}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey},NOW())
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, item_id, quantity, unit_price, line_amount, create_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{itemId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{lineAmount}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, user_id AS userId, order_type AS orderType, total_amount AS totalAmount, status AS "status", create_at AS "createAt" FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND delete_at is null
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, update_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND delete_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT item_id AS itemId, sum(quantity) AS quantity FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND delete_at is null GROUP BY item_id

SELECT order_id AS "orderId", user_id AS "userId", order_type AS "orderType", total_amount AS "totalAmount", status AS "status", create_at AS "createAt" FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND delete_at IS NULL

SELECT seq AS "seq", order_id AS "orderId", item_id AS "itemId", quantity AS "quantity", unit_price AS "unitPrice", line_amount AS "lineAmount", create_at AS "createAt" FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY seq ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET total_amount = #{totalAmount}, update_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND delete_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS "orderId", user_id AS "userId", order_type AS "orderType", total_amount AS "totalAmount", status AS "status", create_at AS "createAt" FROM orders WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND user_id = #{userId} AND delete_at is null LIMIT 1
